name: Standard Demo Flood Scenario
description: 72-hour synthetic monsoon event across North Lakhimpur corridor demonstrating deteriorating access, confirmed road closure, shelter overflow, conflicting and stale reports, and resource strain.
required_demo_situations: Deteriorating access: rain buildup triggers road flood risk across low-lying segments near Subansiri/Ranganadi
Confirmed closure: segment flood probability crosses threshold causing simulated road closure
Insufficient shelter or transport capacity: relief camps reach capacity limit causing shelter overflow events
Conflicting or stale reports: citizen reports arrive delayed or contradicting actual ground truth
Unserved settlements and replanning: settlements cut off with unmet rescue/supply needs
